title: Going Back Is Not Undo: irreversible side effects of web agents and reversibility-aware test-time compute

title: ThaiVoice-GUIBench: spoken Thai and Thai-English single-step GUI grounding benchmark

title: Visual-privileged on-policy self-distillation for GUI grounding
